design.decision: Bid up when holding a winner in every suit, then play to win once in each.
design.opponent: Revealed on the fourth suit won; opponents can deny the last suit by voiding and trumping it.
design.rationale: The bid-tension Rainbow payoff, on the condition that measured strongly in the pilot (seed-rainbow-mult +6.7).
design.draftText: +10 contract points for each trick in your team's contract if your team wins tricks with all four suits

critic.concerns: Scaling plus a four-suit condition (C=6) is a departure; seed-rainbow-mult already covers the condition more simply.
